title: SSC CGL preparation roadmap
overview: A subject-oriented practice route. This is an illustrative learning plan, not an official syllabus. Check current SSC notices before planning for an exam cycle.

stages.title: Quantitative Aptitude
stages.description: Build numerical fluency before timed practice.

topics.title: Number basics
topics.description: Review arithmetic, fractions, percentages, and ratios through worked examples.

topics.title: Quantitative practice
topics.description: Apply number skills to mixed problem sets and record recurring errors.

stages.title: Reasoning
stages.description: Practice patterns and clear problem-solving steps.

topics.title: Reasoning foundations
topics.description: Work through common verbal and non-verbal reasoning patterns.

topics.title: Timed reasoning
topics.description: Complete short timed sets and review the method behind each error.

topics.title: Reading practice
topics.description: Read short passages, summarize ideas, and check comprehension.

topics.title: English usage
topics.description: Practice grammar and vocabulary in context.

stages.title: General Awareness
stages.description: Use dependable sources and regular revision.

topics.title: Build concise notes
topics.description: Organize broad general awareness topics using reliable sources.

topics.title: Recall and review
topics.description: Use short quizzes and revisit weak areas.

topics.title: Mixed practice
topics.description: Attempt mixed sets and analyze accuracy by subject.

topics.title: Revision plan
topics.description: Create a repeatable review schedule based on mistakes.

title: IBPS PO preparation roadmap
overview: A subject-oriented route for banking aptitude. It is an illustrative learning plan, not an official syllabus or exam pattern.

topics.title: Arithmetic foundations
topics.description: Practice percentages, ratios, averages, and calculations.

topics.title: Applied quantitative sets
topics.description: Solve mixed questions and review accuracy.

topics.title: Reasoning fundamentals
topics.description: Work through logic and pattern exercises with written steps.

topics.title: Puzzle practice
topics.description: Practice multi-step sets and review where time is lost.

topics.title: Reading comprehension
topics.description: Read and summarize passages before answering questions.

topics.title: Language practice
topics.description: Review grammar, vocabulary, and sentence clarity.

topics.title: Choose reliable sources
topics.description: Set a weekly reading and note-taking routine.

topics.title: Weekly recall
topics.description: Summarize and revisit key themes without memorizing unsupported claims.

topics.title: Timed mixed sets
topics.description: Attempt mixed practice and track weak areas.

topics.title: Targeted revision
topics.description: Revisit mistakes and adjust the next practice block.

title: UI/UX Design learning roadmap
overview: A project-oriented path from design foundations to a small portfolio case study. Estimated time is a planning guide and varies by learner.

stages.title: Design Fundamentals
stages.description: Learn the language of useful interfaces.

topics.title: Interface principles
topics.description: Study hierarchy, spacing, contrast, and accessible defaults.

topics.title: Critique an interface
topics.description: Describe what works and what creates friction in a familiar app.

stages.title: User Research
stages.description: Understand a real problem before drawing screens.

topics.title: Frame a user problem
topics.description: Write a focused problem statement and assumptions.

topics.title: Research conversations
topics.description: Prepare open questions and synthesize a few observations.

topics.title: Map a task flow
topics.description: Outline the steps a user takes to complete one task.

topics.title: Low-fidelity wireframes
topics.description: Sketch multiple layouts and choose one to test.

stages.title: Visual Design
stages.description: Turn structure into a consistent interface.

topics.title: Create a visual system
topics.description: Define type, color, spacing, and basic components.

topics.title: Design key screens
topics.description: Apply the system to a small set of connected screens.

topics.title: Build a prototype
topics.description: Link key screens and make primary actions clear.

topics.title: Run a usability check
topics.description: Watch someone attempt the task and record friction.

stages.title: Portfolio Project
stages.description: Explain the work and what changed.

topics.title: Refine the design
topics.description: Use test observations to improve the interface.

topics.title: Write a case study
topics.description: Document the problem, process, decisions, and outcome.
